description: This file defines functions and constants for accessing embedded resource forks in files, including guessing resource fork locations, retrieving header info, and obtaining data offsets within resource forks, as part of the FreeType project.

methods.name: FT_Raccess_Guess
methods.description: Guesses the file name and offset where the resource fork is stored based on various rules.

methods.name: FT_Raccess_Get_HeaderInfo
methods.description: Retrieves header information from a resource fork, including map offset and data position.

methods.name: FT_Raccess_Get_DataOffsets
methods.description: Obtains data offsets for a specific resource tag within a resource fork.
